description: Source code for the LifecycleManager class implementation, managing lifecycle states and interactions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: LifecycleManager
classes.description: Manages lifecycle states and interactions for the plugin, including initialization, deinitialization, and state notifications.

methods.name: LifecycleManager
methods.description: Constructor, initializes singleton instance and logs startup.

methods.name: ~LifecycleManager
methods.description: Destructor, cleans up resources and resets singleton instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lifecycle manager with the provided service, sets up interfaces and state notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters state notifications, releases interfaces, and terminates remote connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with service information.
